tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

trace.error_message: Rollout halted after us-east: orchestrator error

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. (v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging.) We rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error, which left the regions on different versions for a short time. A retry finished the rollout in all regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west and eu-west; service healthy; error rate 0.2%. Follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and investigate the orchestrator error that stopped the rollback partway.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** The bad release was v2.3.1. Its test version (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed in staging. v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
  - My first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error. That left us-east on v2.3.0 and us-west and eu-west still on v2.3.1.
  - Rolling back to the same version is safe to repeat, so I retried once and it finished.
- **Current state:** All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are on v2.3.0. The service is healthy, and the error rate is down from 18% to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** The request to open INC-0001 timed out. I retried it with the same ID so it couldn't create a duplicate, and only one incident exists. It explains the failure, the rollback (including the partial stop and retry) and the current state.

INC-0001 lists two follow-ups: find out why v2.3.1 failed, and investigate the orchestrator error that stopped the rollback partway.
